title: The last five minutes are scored, and they are your due diligence
takeaway: Bring two or three questions per interviewer about how the work really runs, and let the answers change your decision.
sources: That is a scored moment, and it scores badly.
Not because it is rude, but because it tells the interviewer you are evaluating nothing.
The single highest-information question in this list.
Vagueness here is the most reliable red flag in the whole interview.

items.ifSkipped: Saying no tells the interviewer you are evaluating nothing
You miss CI, test suite health, review culture and release process in one answer
You miss the most reliable red flag in the interview: vagueness
An undefined role can turn into something different from what you interviewed for

items.item: Match the question to the person
items.ifSkipped: Asking the wrong person is itself a small negative signal
It consumes time you could spend learning about the work
